name: smwgraphics-garfield-and-his-nine-lives-gba-haunted-house
title: Garfield and His Nine Lives (GBA) - Haunted House
description:
Here I am with another BG from the GBA game. Ripped the BG with the Lunar Magic Bitmap Pasting Feature. I used the tool again to free 2 extra colors of palette 5. Also, I used the 2nd bright color as back area color to avoid color conflicts.
Also, the BG uses the blank Map16 tile from page BB.
Hope it works for you and use the recommended BG scrolling in the sample file.
